native_word_contract.target: uint32 registry ID by default; registry_landing uses existing valid aligned sentinel domain. Compute hi=((target+0x8000)>>16)&0xffff, lo=target&0xffff; LUI=(0x3c00|reg)<<16 |hi; ADDIU=(0x2400|(reg<<5)|reg)<<16 |lo. Signed low reconstructs modulo2^32.
native_word_contract.data: pointer_array raw pointer_vma; struct_table_field must additionally bind struct_vma+field_offset==pointer_vma with aligned nonoverflow coordinates, following existing append strictness. Historical sparse struct entries without coordinates remain held rather than inferred.
native_word_contract.code: Known nonzero register; lui_vma<addiu_vma, mapped/aligned/inbounds32-bit; no data/struct fields. Exact expected full opcodes/register fields; supports ADDIU only, no ORI/load/store/immediate heuristics. Gap between words allowed as already reviewed append policy, but no control-flow/liveness proof inferred.
native_word_contract.scope: Physical sort; exactly existing8B LE(word,siteVMA) record per physical guarded word. Reject overlap/duplicates/sharedLUI rather than deduplicate ownership. Existing data scope bytes unchanged. Full source/glyph/scope pins and source readback remain mandatory.
native_word_contract.semantics: Failclosed success means all declared physical words equal expected words under pinned source. Mismatch is failure, not recovered target/EN text, not exhaustive consumer/site discovery. Never mutate pointer states or registry status.
native_word_contract.identity_limit: Scope projection binds physical expected words+site VMAs. It is not a complete registry-document identity: when declared landing/site words remain equal, logical metadata changes can leave physical scope equal. Do not infer complete registry ID/content/status ownership from that projection alone; preserve any separately pinned registry evidence.
